title: Rename app to Scholar Gold and update logo/favicon assets

requirements.summary: Rename all user-facing app name text to “Scholar Gold” across the UI (tab title, login brand, header brand, authenticated hero title).
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen brand label displays “Scholar Gold” (replacing “Exam Prep Hub”).
Top header brand label displays “Scholar Gold” (replacing “Exam Prep Hub”).
Authenticated home/hero title displays “Scholar Gold” (replacing “Exam Prep Hub”).

file_operations.description: Update the document <title> to “Scholar Gold” to ensure the browser tab title matches the new app name.
Replace the authenticated landing/hero title text “Exam Prep Hub” with “Scholar Gold” (keep other copy unchanged unless it contains the old brand name).
Replace the header brand label text “Exam Prep Hub” with “Scholar Gold”.
Replace the login screen header brand label text “Exam Prep Hub” with “Scholar Gold”.

requirements.summary: Replace the GraduationCap brand mark with a static image logo and render it crisply in light/dark themes.
acceptanceCriteria: Header brand mark uses an image (not the GraduationCap icon).
Login screen brand mark uses the same image.
Logo image scales correctly and does not appear stretched or pixelated at typical sizes (e.g., 40x40).

file_operations.description: Add the generated “Scholar Gold” square logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_512x512.png for crisp display at smaller sizes.

Replace the GraduationCap-based brand mark with an using frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_512x512.png; ensure sizing (e.g., 40x40) preserves aspect ratio and add light/dark-friendly styling (e.g., subtle ring/contrast) so it remains crisp across themes.

Replace the GraduationCap-based brand mark with the same logo used in the header (frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_512x512.png), keeping consistent sizing and theme-friendly presentation.

requirements.summary: Configure favicon/app icons using the provided “Scholar Gold” generated images and reference them from the HTML entry point.
acceptanceCriteria: A favicon is configured and visible in the browser tab.
Icon assets are served as static files from the frontend (no backend routing).
The configured icon files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced from the HTML entry point.

file_operations.description: Add the generated PWA/large icon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_192x192.png.
Add the generated favicon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-favicon.dim_32x32.png.

Add favicon/app icon <link> tags referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-favicon.dim_32x32.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_192x192.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon.dim_512x512.png so browsers pick up the updated icon assets.
